observed_limitation: Strong class imbalance: class 1 dominates with about 9.44M pixels, while classes 2 and 4 contain only about 5K and 7.6K pixels respectively. The model performs very well on class 1, partially learns class 3, performs weakly on class 2, and does not learn class 4 in this run.
